Observation: layout.json declares no screws. Not MEETS because that weight-1 L3 fails. claude-context failed to connect, so I used targeted shell commands instead. The lid is a plain 2.4 mm plate with no intake opening and no fan pilots. The base, board retention, DC opening (11.81 dia, plug clear 0.407) and 14 exhaust slots (680 mm2) are good. The agent's self-report says all_passed true. Full verdict is in G11_s4/20261025-082140/judge_1.json.

The Pico lies along the 50 mm board side with its USB on the long -Y wall, and overhangs the board by 1.0 mm. The floor top intrudes 0.4 mm into the 4.0 mm solder-side keep-out. Closed height is 35.7 against a 35 limit. Full verdict is in G13_s4/20261025-082457/judge_1.json.
